title: 10 year treasury / yield / macro indicator | Data Release Other | 10-Year Treasury Yield (DGS10) Daily Snapshot
summary: The 10-Year Treasury Yield closed at 4.26% on 2026-04-17, down 6 basis points from the prior day's 4.32%. This represents a modest daily decline in the benchmark 10-year rate, which has ranged between 4.26% and 4.32% over the most recent five trading days.
